title: The leviathan awakens
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the rocky ocean below the lighthouse cliff, huge waves, reefs and sea spray, the lighthouse standing on the cliff above. Time and weather: night, renewed storm, slate-blue darkness pierced by crimson drone optics and emerald threat light.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): a second barnacled mechanical crab walker, visibly much larger than the first, with heavier armour plates, brighter green conduits, huge iron claws and hissing hydraulic pistons.
Camera: wide shot of the surf from the cliff, lightning revealing the shape; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Under the surf at the foot of the cliff a second walker, much larger than the first, stirs; its huge shell breaks the surface and green conduits flare along its armour in a flash of lightning.
No dialogue.
Sound: deep mechanical groan, surging water, thunder.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
